estimators.ratio: mean over rounds of (subject Mops / baseline Mops) measured in the same process in the same round, with a one-sample BCa 95% interval over those paired quotients — not a two-sample ratio of the two columns beside it
estimators.columns: per-arm columns are means of the same rounds' Mops/s; latency figures are percentiles of per-window mean ns/op, not of single-op latency
estimators.raw: every cell carries rounds_raw, the per-round samples and that process's load
